title: Barbaad Karbala Me Hua Fatima ka Ghar
body:
Barbaad Karbala main huwa Fatima ka ghar
Ek dopaher main kaisa bhara ghar ujad gaya, bhayi se bhayi baap se beta bichhad gaya, baad-e-Hussain hogayi Zainab ba rehna sar
Khaa kar sina jo abkar-e-mehroo guzar gaye, maadar ke khwab tooth ke pal main bikhar gaye, gham main jawa pisar ke na phat jaye ab jigar
Sukha gala wo teer-e-sitam wa musibataa, dasht-e- atash main ghuncha dahan ka tha hausla, aur uss pa muskurana jawaban wo teer par
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaadi bhi iss taraah ki na dekhi gayi kahin, mehmaan nawazi ke liye pani bhi ab nahi, laasha hasan ke laal ka hai khoo main tar ba tar
Jab baad-e-asr ran main kata shah ha ka galla, tareeq aandhiyou se huwa dasht-e-Karbala, dekha taveel naize pa Zainab ne sheh ka sar
Khaime hain shola poosh nighebaan ab nahi, ahle-e-haram ki ass ka samaan ab nahi, maidan mein bibiya sabhi baithi hain khaak par
Nahanni si jaan pa kaisi qayamat guzar gayi, ruqsar nilgun hain toh gardan bandhi hui, kaano ke khoon se phata kurta hai tar ba tar, ahl-e-haram ko rassi main laaye hain bandh kar, kya bekasi barasti hain aal-e-rasool par, paishe-e-yazid Zainab-e-muztar hain nange sar
<<DIVIDER>>
Touq-e-garaan mein Abid-e-bimaar allama, wo tezz dhoop durrou se aazaar allama, shukre-e-khuda sohail tha unki zubaan par..
